name: vwap_mean_reversion_v11
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the z-score relative to the 20-minute rolling standard deviation drops below -2.5 (typically 60-90 spot points below session VWAP at VIX 15-25 sessions), the selling transitions from discretionary VWAP-urgency accumulation to forced margin liquidation of leveraged long positions hitting stop-loss limits — a qualitatively different seller archetype with a hard supply ceiling. Once this forced-sell pool is depleted, there is no new supply to replace it and the bid side re-asserts abruptly. The microstructure signature of exhaustion is price beginning to lift within the 30-second window even while the z-score remains deeply negative: the close reclaims more than 30% of the 6-bar (30-second) high-low range from below, indicating that the forced sellers have been absorbed and market makers are aggressively raising bid ladders. On NIFTY, this forced-exhaustion pattern at -2.5 sigma produces a 25-35 spot point snap-back within 60 seconds as the vacuum left by exhausted sellers fills with VWAP-benchmarked buy programs that had been holding back to avoid chasing the forced-sell cascade.
core_signal_oneliner: Forced-liquidation exhaustion at -2.5 sigma VWAP deviation, confirmed by 30-second range reclaim above 30% from the low
